# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** 14-15 years old  <sub>[v1 c21 P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043), [v1 c29 P4](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c21 P40](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0040), [v1 c21 P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c21 P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043), [v1 c21 P55](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0055)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden and hired girl for Miss Lavendar Lewis  <sub>[v1 c21 P40](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0040), [v1 c21 P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043)</sub>
- **Titles:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v1 c21 P40](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0040)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta is a freckled girl with a snub nose and a mouth so wide that it seems to stretch from ear to ear. She wears her fair hair braided into two long plaits tied with enormous blue ribbon bows that stick out like wings. She tries to emulate Anne Shirley's walk, posture, and expressions.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P21](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0021), [v1 c21 P27](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0027), [v1 c21 P28](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0028), [v1 c21 P39](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0039)_

## Personality

Charlotta is an extremely energetic, brisk, and devoted handmaiden who takes immense pride in her work and in her mistress. She is deeply loyal, earnest, and prone to dramatic, anxious worrying whenever things might go wrong. Though occasionally blunt or superstitious, she is warm-hearted, obedient, and eagerly accommodating to those she admires.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028), [v1 c21 P12](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0012), [v1 c21 P16](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0016), [v1 c21 P28](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0028), [v1 c21 P55](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0055), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032)_

## Traits

- Devoted and loyal  <sub>[v1 c21 P55](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0055), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032)</sub>
- Brisk and energetic  <sub>[v1 c21 P12](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0012)</sub>
- Anxious and pessimistic under pressure  <sub>[v1 c21 P16](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0016), [v1 c21 P22](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0022)</sub>
- Imitative of those she admires  <sub>[v1 c21 P39](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Housekeeping, cooking, and cleaning  <sub>[v1 c21 P12](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0012), [v1 c21 P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To serve and care for Miss Lavendar faithfully  <sub>[v1 c21 P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043), [v1 c21 P55](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0055)</sub>
- To learn to move, speak, and act with the grace of Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c21 P39](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0039)</sub>

## History

Leonora Bowman entered the service of Miss Lavendar Lewis at Echo Lodge when she was thirteen years old, following her three older sisters who had previously served in the same role. Because her predecessors had all been called Charlotta by Miss Lavendar, she was dubbed 'Charlotta the Fourth.' When Anne Shirley and Diana Barry accidentally stumbled upon Echo Lodge, Charlotta welcomed them and assisted Miss Lavendar in entertaining them. She formed a deep admiration for Anne, attempting to mimic her graceful mannerisms. When Stephen Irving returned to courtship with Miss Lavendar, Charlotta eagerly supported the romance and helped prepare for the wedding. Following the marriage of Stephen and Miss Lavendar, Charlotta relocated to Boston with them to continue her service.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P21](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0021), [v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 c21 P12](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0012), [v1 c21 P39](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0039), [v1 c21 P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043), [v1 c21 P55](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0055), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032), [v1 c29 P10](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v1 c21 P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043)</sub>
- Fourth daughter in the Bowman family to work as hired girl for Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v1 c21 P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043)</sub>
- Hired at age thirteen to live with Miss Lavendar for board and clothes  <sub>[v1 c21 P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043)</sub>
